intro: Professionals and everyday users convert us short tons (ton (US)) to pounds (lb) when working across us_customary and imperial standards in engineering specifications, international trade documentation, and technical measurements. One us short ton equals 2,000 pounds, while 1 pound (avoirdupois) equals 0.0005 us short tons. Whether you are verifying mass & weight specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Short Ton (US) vs. Metric Tonne (t) vs. Long Ton (UK)
items: Three distinct units are called a "ton": the US Short Ton equals 2,000 lbs (907.185 kg), the Metric Tonne (t) equals 1,000 kg (2,204.62 lbs), and the British Imperial Long Ton equals 2,240 lbs (1,016.05 kg).
Confusing US short tons with metric tonnes introduces a 10.2% freight weight error on international bills of lading.

faqs.question: How many pounds (lb) are in 1 us short ton (ton (US))?
faqs.answer: There are 2,000 pounds (lb) in 1 us short ton (ton (US)), which rounds to 2,000 lb for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 pound (avoirdupois) equals 0.0005 us short tons.

faqs.question: How do I convert us short tons to pounds (ton (US) to lb)?
faqs.answer: To convert us short tons to pounds, use the formula: lb = ton (US) × 2,000. For example, converting 10 ton (US) gives 20,000 lb.

faqs.question: What is 10 us short tons in pounds?
faqs.answer: 10 us short tons (ton (US)) equals exactly 20,000 pounds (lb) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
